title: Trading Platforms Enterprise Software Architect
location: WP. Kuala Lumpur, Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
description: About Us HFM is an internationally acclaimed multi-asset broker, delivering cutting-edge trading tools, platforms, and conditions to traders worldwide. We are committed to innovation, transparency, and excellence in the financial markets. As we continue to expand, HFM is seeking a driven Trading Platforms Enterprise Software Architect to join our team. You will design and build software architecture on and around MetaQuotes MT4 and MT5 trading platforms, set development standards and write code alongside Platforms teams. Responsibilities: Own end-to-end architecture for applications built on and around MT4/MT5 trading servers. Set platform software design and development standards, including application impact on live trading servers. Own integration architecture between trading servers and the wider estate, including liquidity and price-feed integration. Define platform software security and observability as architectural requirements. Prepare platform applications for containers and Kubernetes / Amazon EKS, aligned with the estate modernization roadmap. Write production code and build shared libraries and proofs of concept for platform applications. Collaborate with architects, engineering teams and stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust, scalable solutions. Mentor engineers and support routine, verifiable and reversible trading-platform changes. Requirements Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering or related field, or equivalent experience. 10+ years of hands-on software engineering, including several years architecting software on or around a live electronic trading platform. Fluency in English; additional languages would be considered an advantage. Deep knowledge of the MetaQuotes MT4/MT5 ecosystem, including the Manager API. Expert proficiency in C# and .NET, strong C++ for plugin development, and advanced SQL. Strong understanding of distributed systems, concurrency and high availability in high-throughput, mission-critical systems; experience designing Windows applications for Kubernetes / Amazon EKS is a strong plus. Experience with liquidity and price-feed integration, including bridge platforms such as PrimeXM. Familiarity with the regulated-broker environment (CySEC, MiFID II) as it constrains platform design. Excellent communicator who can translate complex technical concepts for diverse stakeholders. Resumes must be submitted in English. Applicants must be eligible or have legal authorization to work in the country where the position is based. Hybrid Work Model (2 days working from home) Comprehensive Health Insurance (from day one!) 21 days of Annual Leave Birthday Leave Referral Bonus Program Additional Support Visa Sponsorship and Relocation Assistance (If applicable) Sounds like you? Let’s write the next chapter together! All Applications will be handled with the strictest confidentiality.
